source_text: If the measured concentration exceeds the configured upper range, the display changes to >RANGE and the high alarm relay energizes. Move the instrument to fresh air and allow the reading to return below the range before resuming measurement; do not treat the over-range indication as a numeric concentration. SENSOR OPEN is shown when the sensing element circuit is disconnected or its resistance is outside the permitted interval. The measurement output is held at fault level and the fault relay activates. Isolate the detector from process service and inspect the sensor connector; replace the sensing element if the connection is secure and the fault remains.

source_text: After power-up, the display shows WARMING and the reading is suppressed for up to 90 seconds. When the warm-up interval ends, the live gas concentration appears. CAL DUE flashes when 180 days have elapsed since the last successful calibration; measurements remain available, but accuracy is not assured. Perform a zero and span calibration using the approved procedure, then acknowledge the reminder.

trigger_conditions: The instrument has just been powered up.
manifestations: The reading is suppressed for up to 90 seconds.
The live gas concentration appears when the warm-up interval ends.

source_text: During the self-test, SENSOR AGING is reported if the electrochemical cell response falls below the service threshold. The display alternates SENSOR AGING with the gas reading, and the event log records a maintenance warning; measurement remains enabled. Arrange a sensor response check at the next planned service visit. After a replacement cell passes the response check, clear the warning from the service menu; the display returns to the normal measurement screen.
